title: Read as You See: Guiding Unimodal LLMs for Low-Resource Explainable Harmful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) classification accuracy and F1 scores on detecting racially hateful memes using human-crafted guidelines on datasets like FHM and MultiOFF.

Evaluating zero-shot CoT classification performance on misogynistic and sexist memes using targeted guidelines (e.g., identifying objectification, body shaming, and harmful stereotypes) on datasets like MAMI, GoatBench, and FHM.
Evaluating zero-shot CoT classification performance on homophobic and transphobic memes using targeted guidelines for LGBTQ+ content on datasets like PrideMM and MultiOFF.
Evaluating zero-shot CoT classification performance on harmful political memes targeting specific politicians, political parties, or ideologies using datasets like Harm-P, HarMeme, and MultiOFF.
Evaluating zero-shot CoT classification performance on hateful memes targeting religious groups (e.g., Islamophobia, Antisemitism) using human-crafted guidelines on datasets like FHM and MultiOFF.
Extracting visual cues regarding disability and evaluating zero-shot CoT classification performance on hateful memes targeting people with disabilities using the FHM dataset.
